metadata.label: MDeCUR-full-dense-token-v2
prediction: legacy global and RNA-conditioned pathway interaction
local common/private coordinates directly enter hazard logits
metadata.dense_matching: independently encoded patch/pathway tokens, shared-space nearest neighbor
metadata.dense_max_tokens_scope: sampled valid pathology tokens per patient; all RNA pathway tokens
limits: DenseTwins-inspired WSI/bulk-RNA adaptation, not author-code replication.
Nearest-neighbor selection can induce correlation under independent modalities.
Conditional prediction tokens are not independent common-information evidence.
Patient-level generalization and interaction gains require matched controls.

settings.selection: maximum validation Harrell C, earliest exact tie
settings.metric_convention: legacy scoring plus separately labelled finite-edge audit
settings.batching: same epoch order and merged tail for all arms; minimum B=hidden+1

finite_edge_audit.risk_definition: minus the summed survival over every original discrete bin
finite_edge_audit.time_mapping: S[:, j] is evaluated at finite internal training edge bins[j+1]
finite_edge_audit.grid_rule: Training edges only, restricted to shared follow-up range and positive training G.
finite_edge_audit.time_dependent_scope: Finite internal boundaries only; no open-bin endpoint or interpolation.
finite_edge_audit.boundary_caution: Discrete bin-boundary approximation; exact event/edge ties follow sksurv scoring.
finite_edge_audit.selection_caution: This rescore does not undo validation-based checkpoint or model selection.
